title: SF2328 (2021-2022 Regular): Constitutional amendment protecting the right of people to keep and bear arms

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-03-25; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/SF/2328/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Read the introduced bill (2021-03-25); no vote data in file. Ballot question quote stops before the Yes/No lines.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Constitution, art. I, new section 18): A well regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed.
Section 2 (submission to voters): "Shall the Minnesota Constitution be amended to protect the right of the people to keep and bear arms?
